name: Lovers Paranoia
source:
You decided to move from your hometown to an island to start over a new leaf. What better way to run from all of your problems than to move to an island full of mysteries? It was a huge struggle to get your parents to agree to your move, but you managed in the end!

You knew that... Once you move to the island... There is no way out of it. Luckily, you meet my trusty friend to help you out.

[From [url=https://illuscape.itch.io/lovers-paranoia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你决定从家乡搬到一个小岛上开始新的生活。还有什么比搬到一个充满神秘的岛屿更好的方式来摆脱所有的问题呢？为了让你的父母同意你的搬家经历了一场巨大的斗争，但你最终成功了！

你知道…一旦你搬到岛上…就没有出路了。幸运的是，你遇到了我值得信赖的朋友来帮助你。

[来自[url=https://illuscape.itch.io/lovers-paranoia]Itch.io[/url]]
